title: A Second Ride
paras: Mina makes wooden toys in a small shop. Some families near her shop have little [[money|money]] for new toys. She puts a box by her door. A sign says, “Broken toys? Leave them here, [[please|please]]. I can fix them for free.” Her brother thinks this is a good idea. “I [[agree|agree]],” says Mina. “An old toy can make a child happy again.”

One Monday, [[someone|someone]] leaves a wooden horse in the box. It has three wheels, not four. Its blue paint is old. Mina makes a new wheel from [[hard|hard]] wood. At first, she can [[hear|hear]] a [[terrible|terrible]] sound when she pushes the horse. The wheel rubs against its side. She takes the wheel off and makes it smaller. Then she paints two bright eyes on the horse.

On Friday, a little boy comes with his father. “My horse!” he says. He pushes it across the floor. It moves well [[now|now]]. “It runs like a [[real|real]] horse!” he says. Mina smiles. She likes to [[feel|feel]] that her work helps people. Before they leave, his father puts another broken toy in the box for her to fix.
zh: 米娜在一家小店里做木制玩具。店铺附近有些家庭没有多少钱买新玩具。她在门边放了一个箱子。牌子上写着：“有坏掉的玩具吗？请放在这里。我可以免费修好。”她的兄弟觉得这个主意很好。“我也这么想，”米娜说，“旧玩具也能让孩子重新开心起来。”
一个星期一，有人在箱子里放了一匹小木马。它只有三个轮子，而不是四个。它身上的蓝漆已经旧了。米娜用坚硬的木头做了一个新轮子。起初，她推小木马时，能听到一阵难听的声音。轮子蹭到了马身。她把轮子卸下来，改小了一点。然后，她给小木马画上了两只明亮的眼睛。
星期五，一个小男孩和爸爸一起来了。“我的马！”他说。他推着小木马，让它在地板上跑。现在，它跑得很顺畅。“它跑起来像一匹真马！”他说。米娜笑了。她喜欢那种自己的工作能帮到别人的感觉。离开前，男孩的爸爸又往箱子里放了一个坏玩具，请她修理。

q.s: Families do not have to pay Mina to repair their toys.
q.why: 牌子上说她可以免费修理玩具。

q.s: Mina buys wood to make the new wheel.
q.why: 文中未说明制作新轮子的木头是否买来。

q.s: The boy comes to the shop alone on Friday.
q.why: 星期五男孩是和爸爸一起来的。
